Act 4 · Survive

Keep it

  • ⇧
    Run, crouch, hide · running costs energy
  • ☼
    Stay in the light · UV lamps need fuel
  • Q
    Throw and distract · noise pulls a pack away

    Hold a base · stock it, then move on

They were people you knew

A fungus that hates light. They keep their own clothes, so Chai Anna still carries his kettle.

Nothing dies, until late

Psychology

Rewards early, challenge that grows, nothing wasted

First hour · every 5–10 minWelcome winsChai, the bus, a key, a PG. Easy cards and badges.
Middle · every 30–60 minReal milestonesA salary, a scooter, a new station.
Late · slower, biggerThings that matterA base, your people, an ending.

Something new every 20–30 min

A new mechanic keeps curiosity going.

Gentle, then harsh

Acts 1–3 forgive. Act 4 tests.

Effort reused

Your furnished room becomes your first base.

From our notebook · considered, set aside for now (decision 170)

The idea we decided not to build

We thought about hooking players with easy badges early, then making the game harder so that, having invested so much, leaving would feel like a loss (the sunk-cost effect).

We chose not to, for ethical reasons: we want players back because they enjoy the city, not because they feel guilty. We may revisit it one day, but only as a new, public decision.

Status: not in the gameReason: ethicsRevisit: only by a new decision

Future · multiplayer

The Town Hall: meet strangers from anywhere, by chance

The story stays single-player. In the Town Hall you meet whoever is playing right now.
